description: CNT-01 (w3, the content area's entry point) + SPK-05 (w2); 16 of CNT's 31 item-weight flows downstream (CNT-02/04/05/07/08/13 evidence needs a created task). The acceptance cascade already mints tasks at runtime (jobs/cascade/decisions.ts:362) — this is AUTHORING + ad-hoc assignment, not a task engine. (1) Full CRUD on task_templates: POST/DELETE + PATCH beyond file_config (task-templates.routes.ts currently GET + file-config-PATCH only). Fields: name, kind acknowledge|file|form, description, due_at OR due_offset_days (CHECK makes them mutually exclusive — the eval wants literal dates like 2027-05-01, so the UI must expose due_at); kind=form requires form_id. (2) POST for direct speaker-task assignment: title, due date, MULTI-speaker select, bypassing auto_assign. (3) Fix TaskTemplatesPage: remove the file-kind-only filter (:173), give the empty state the control it instructs you to use (:183), sidebar/settings link (EventSettings links venues but not tasks). Full spec: section T-E. Register rows 24,25.
